statement: queer.ath: with the two sides removed (roommates), 0 of 1, 2 of 8 and 48 of 1296 profiles (n = 2, 3, 4) have no stable matching, while the two-sided model has one on all 46656 n=3 profiles; with k two-valued traits 2^k - 2 combinations are not aligned, and on the 1/4 grid (k <= 4) no threshold on one trait reproduces another. Prevalence figures of 1.7% and 0.018% are published and not chosen between. The readings (Butler, Stryker, Stone, Serano, Sedgwick, Beauvoir) are analogy or open.
